accuracy_assessment.issue: patient.dob: Glossary uses abbreviated business term 'Dob' while semantic model uses full 'Date of Birth'
accuracy_assessment.recommendation: Standardize business term naming - use full descriptive names consistently across both artifacts

accuracy_assessment.issue: prescriber.npi_number: Glossary uses abbreviated business term 'Npi Number' while semantic model uses full 'NPI Number'
accuracy_assessment.recommendation: Standardize business term naming - use consistent capitalization and abbreviation patterns

efficiency_assessment.issue: Multiple metrics compute similar per-entity ratios (prescriptions_per_patient, prescriptions_per_prescriber, revenue_per_patient, revenue_per_prescriber) using identical calculation patterns
efficiency_assessment.recommendation: Consider creating a reusable parameterized metric template for 'per-entity' calculations to reduce code duplication

efficiency_assessment.issue: Several metrics (total_prescriptions, fulfilled_prescription_count, new_prescription_count, refill_prescription_count) use nearly identical SQL patterns with only WHERE clause differences
efficiency_assessment.recommendation: Consider consolidating into a single base metric with filter parameters or creating shared CTEs for reusability
